# Show-me: visual explanations

Curated by Skill Harbor — @humanlayer's visual-explanation skill: when discussing a topic, skip the preamble and pick the smallest view that makes the key point clear — logic as pseudocode, control flow as a call tree, UI structure as a component tree, file responsibility as a shallow tree, interactions as Mermaid diagrams, changes as diffs (matched to the topic: component, file layout, call tree, state flow), the whole block when context matters, and for dense visual concepts a single focused HTML file (diagram, infographic, or short slide deck) matched to the product's styling. Honest caveats: guidance only — the HTML artifacts may need the agent to open them in a browser for the user; MIT-licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
